notes.title: Rise & Shine first patch is now LIVE.
notes.notes:
Release notes:

-Launcher is gone: New ingame settings for Resolution.
-Support for 16:10 Resolutions.
-Added new settings Vibration(On/Off) and language.
-DX9 Support.

Balance Changes:
-Last part of the game is a bit easier and less frustrating.
-Lowered time required for the Bullet Hell Minigame.
-Added more time to hit the weak point of the Huge Robot Boss.
-Enemy bullets are easier to see now.

Fixes:
-Infinite loading after a cloud save corruption.
-Coconut pieces now disapear after a short time so the button cant be blocked.
-Crash when trying to skip story comics.
-Other minor bugs.


Sorry for the wait!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Rise & Shine, 20% off!
notes.notes:
Rise & Shine is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

Welcome to Gamearth, a once peaceful planet now threatened by the warmongering Space grunts of Nexgen. In the aftermath of their devastating first strike a child named Rise is forced to take on the sacred gun Shine - and with it the fate of his world.

*Offer ends January 20 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Rise & Shine is running and gunning onto Steam today
notes.notes: Adult Swim are releasing their run ‘n’ gun game Rise & Shine [official site] today via Steam. It features a boy and his talking gun shooting their way through gaming history when their colourful world is invaded by the forces of Next Gen in the form of zombies, marines and the like. The trailer, which you can see below, doesn’t make the distinction between the old and the new seem strange enough for my liking, but the backdrops are gorgeous. … [visit site to read more]
